summary: Backend-only test of the content-LENGTH calibration pass (moderate word/sentence caps reintroduced via SYSTEM_PL + explicit 'X pełne zdania (ok. Y-Z słów)' targets). End-to-end flow with a fresh user: register -> PUT /api/profile -> POST /api/recommendations/generate -> poll -> GET /api/careers/{id} -> POST /api/roadmap/custom (elektryk) -> poll /api/roadmap -> GET /api/roadmap/tasks/{id}/resources. All 5 pytest cases passed. Output quality is genuinely the right middle ground: full flowing sentences (never dash/fragment style), word counts landing very close to the stated targets across every field.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1384 lines - growing large; consider splitting LLM-prompt-building logic into a separate module in a future refactor pass (not blocking).
seed_data_creation: Created one fresh test user (TEST_lencalib_*@test.pl), one recommendations doc, one career_detail cache entry, one custom roadmap path 'elektryk', one task_resources cache entry — all isolated test data in preview DB, no cleanup needed per test design (prefixed TEST_).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Exact measured outputs with word/sentence counts captured in test stdout (see pytest_iter34.xml or rerun test file with -s -n 0 for full printed text). Key samples: profile summary = 68 words/3 sentences (target 60-80w/3-4s) ✓; career now-item summary/why ~19-28 words/2 sentences each (target 25-35w/2s, slightly under but full sentences) ✓; career_detail.description = 63 words/4 sentences (target 50-65w/3s) ✓; how_to_start avg 21.7 words/step (target 15-20w) ✓ slightly over but fine; roadmap milestone descriptions 32-37 words/2 sentences (target 30-40w/2s) ✓; roadmap task descriptions 14-17 words (target 15-20w) ✓; task_resources overview = 59 words/3 sentences (target 55-70w/3s) ✓; steps ~25-35 words each (target 15-20w, somewhat over but still full coherent sentences, not fragments) - worth a light trim if main agent wants closer adherence but not a bug. free_tips 12-20 words (target 12-16w) ✓. Concrete named courses/platforms/urzędy pracy still present (HubSpot Academy, SEP Wrocław, KFS, Pracuj.pl etc) confirming the 'be concrete' rule survived the length trim. No fragment/dash-style outputs observed anywhere. Overall this is a good middle ground — neither ultra-terse nor bloated.
rca_of_issue: No bugs found. Only test-script friction: /api/profile is PUT not POST (fixed in test script, not a backend issue).
